message.content:
A typical **McDonald’s Big Mac** contains roughly **≈ 550 kcal** (about 2,300 kJ) per sandwich.  
That figure comes straight from McDonald’s U.S. nutrition facts sheet:

| Item | Calories |
|------|----------|
| Big Mac (single patty + bun + sauce + lettuce & cheese) | ~550 kcal |

> *Note:* Calorie counts may vary slightly depending on regional recipes or ingredient substitutions. In some markets the Big Mac might contain around 540–560 kcal; if you’re looking at a “Big Mac” sold outside the United States it could differ by a few dozen calories due to local ingredients or portion sizes.
